name: oryn-browser
description: A quiet, privacy-respecting browser for everyday browsing.

scripts.lint: node --check src/main.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check ui/app.js
scripts.dist:mac: npm run icons && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run icons && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run icons && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist: npm run dist:mac && npm run dist:win && npm run dist:linux
scripts.dist:mac-arm64: npm run icons && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac-x64: npm run icons && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win-x64: npm run icons && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win-arm64: npm run icons && electron-builder --win nsis --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux-x64: npm run icons && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux-arm64: npm run icons && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --arm64 --publish never
